observations: Reaction; choose exactly one of two modes.
The first mode counters a spell; it is not limited to an enemy spell and does not say ability.
The second plays four 1-Might Bird unit tokens with Deflect. No Here or Base-only restriction is printed.
The printed Reaction reminder is expanded on the face; the official gallery text abbreviates it to the keyword.

Hand, instructed play and Repeat reuse canonical mode validation; rejected actions and payment undo preserve state.
UI mode buttons, previews and unobtrusive Beginner/Advanced explanations; API view and requests retain each chosen mode.
